sampling.interleaving: smallest next within-stratum cumulative share, SHA-256 tie-break

interpretation.primary_question: How stable is the fixed-versus-recursive result when the number and naturally co-varying mix of records in each frozen candidate pool are reduced?
interpretation.boundary: The frozen files do not preserve retrieval rank. Results estimate sensitivity to candidate-pool quantity and composition, not the causal effect of a real retrieval top-N cutoff.
interpretation.labels: Machine scope and frozen-group assignments only; evaluator-specific relabeling is not estimated.
